app.title: Chain Factory (WIP)
shop.title: Shop
inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.hint: Pick a part, then click an empty cell to place it. Drag a placed part to move it, drag it here to return it to your inventory, or drag it to the shop to sell it (long-press also works on phones)
selection.title: Selected part
selection.none: Click (tap) a part to select it. Tap again to rotate, long-press to move it back to inventory
controls.commitHint: The final run locks in this shift. Test runs are unlimited, but random parts like the Junkbot behave differently each time
error.notBuilding: You can't do that right now
part.switch.name: Switch
part.switch.desc: Fires a value-1 signal in its facing direction at start
part.conveyor.name: Conveyor
part.conveyor.desc: Sends signals in its facing direction
part.splitter.name: Splitter
part.splitter.desc: Splits a signal to its left and right
part.gear.name: Booster Gear
part.press.name: Press
part.barrel.name: Blast Barrel
part.junkbot.name: Junkbot
part.junkbot.desc: Sends signals in a random direction, multiplying the value by a random ×{junkbotMin}–×{junkbotMax} (seeded)
part.rebooter.name: Rebooter
part.dock.name: Shipping Dock
part.dock.desc: Adds the signal value to your shipment
boss.lowOil.name: Low Oil
boss.repairWork.name: Floor Repairs
boss.repairWork.desc: {cells} cells unusable (shown on the floor). Parts there return to inventory
boss.strictInspection.name: Strict Inspection
boss.strictInspection.desc: Docks ship 1/{divisor} of the value (rounded down)
boss.shortShift.name: Short Shift
boss.partShortage.name: Part Shortage
part.merger.name: Merger
part.merger.desc: Sums all signals entering in the same tick into one
part.chainMeter.name: Chain Meter
part.spreader.name: Spreader
part.spreader.desc: Sends the signal forward, left and right
part.copier.name: Copier
part.copier.desc: Fires the value twice (2nd shot {copierDelay} tick later)
part.reflector.name: Reflector
part.reflector.desc: Bounces signals back the way they came
part.turntable.name: Turntable
part.turntable.desc: Sends forward, then turns 90° clockwise each time
part.oiler.name: Oil Tank
part.oiler.desc: Ignores signals. Adjacent parts get +{oilerBonus} activation
part.coil.name: Resonance Coil
part.solar.name: Solar Panel
part.solar.desc: Adds (empty cells around it × {solarPerEmpty}) to the value
part.inspector.name: Inspection Table
part.inspector.desc: ×{inspectorMultiplier} if next to a Shipping Dock
part.piggyBank.name: Piggy Bank
part.piggyBank.desc: Passes the signal and adds ${piggyBankIncome} next shift (max ${maxIncomePerSim} per run)
break.title: Where the chain broke
break.long.exhausted: Hit a part with no activations left
break.long.inert: Hit a part that ignores signals
debug.title: Debug
break.halted.tickLimit: Stopped by the time limit ({count} left)

settings.shakeHint: Turn this off if you get motion sick. "Minimal" also disables slow-motion and cut-ins
settings.bgmHint: No music yet (the system is ready)
